recipes.title: Warm Japanese Shiso (Yukari), Soft Egg & Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Beloved Japanese morning comfort bowl tossing steaming rice with fragrant dried red shiso flakes or fresh shredded shiso, a soft egg, and sesame seeds.

ingredient_details.item: dried shiso flakes (yukari) or 4 fresh shredded shiso leaves
steaming cooked short-grain or jasmine rice

steps: Fluff hot rice in a bowl and fold in dried shiso flakes (or fresh thinly sliced shiso leaves) and toasted sesame seeds.
Nestle a warm soft-cooked egg right in the center.
Drizzle with toasted sesame oil, top with scallions, and eat warm with a spoon.
tips: In Japan, sprinkling aromatic purple shiso (yukari) over warm morning rice is an everyday staple.
Soft, hydrating, and effortless to chew.

recipes.title: Soothing Shiso, Ginger & Rice Morning Congee
recipes.summary: Velvety warm rice porridge simmered with fresh ginger and broth, finished with fragrant strips of fresh green shiso or dried shiso flakes.

ingredient_details.item: dried shiso leaves (or 6 fresh shiso leaves, thinly sliced)

steps: Simmer cooked rice, broth, and grated ginger in a saucepan 15 minutes until silky and porridge-soft.
Ladle into warm bowls and stir in shiso so the steam releases its bright mint-basil-citrus perfume.
Top with toasted sesame oil and sliced scallions.
tips: Shiso's bright herbal aroma wakes up mild morning congee with zero heaviness.
Add flaked poached salmon or silken tofu for extra protein.

recipes.title: Creamy Avocado, Lemon & Fresh Shiso Toast
recipes.summary: Toasted whole-grain bread layered with lemon-mashed avocado, fragrant shredded shiso leaves, sesame seeds, and a drop of olive oil.

ingredient_details.item: fresh green or red shiso leaves (or 1/2 tsp dried flakes)

steps: Mash ripe avocado with fresh lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Spread generously onto warm whole-grain toast.
Scatter finely snipped shiso, toasted sesame seeds, and a tiny drizzle of olive oil across the top.
tips: Shiso brings a refreshing mint-citrus lift that pairs wonderfully with buttery avocado.
Kitchen shears snip shiso leaves into neat ribbons effortlessly.

recipes.title: Fluffy Japanese-Style Shiso & Scallion Folded Omelet
recipes.summary: Silky low-heat folded omelet scented with finely sliced fresh shiso or dried shiso flakes, scallions, and light rice bran oil.

ingredient_details.item: fresh shiso leaves, finely snipped (or 3/4 tsp dried)

steps: Whisk eggs with soy sauce, 1 tbsp water, snipped shiso, and sliced scallions.
Warm oil over medium-low heat and pour in the egg mixture.
Cook gently 3 minutes, folding softly into tender layers, and slide onto a warm plate.
tips: A tablespoon of water makes folded omelets extra pillowy and gentle to eat.
Serve with sliced cucumber or warm rice.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt, Sweet Plum & Shiso Tea Honey Bowl
recipes.summary: Cool plain Greek yogurt topped with ripe sliced plum or berries, toasted oats, and a rosy drizzle of honey steeped with red shiso.

ingredient_details.item: dried red shiso leaves (or 3 fresh leaves)

steps: Steep shiso leaves in 2 tbsp hot water with honey and lemon juice 3 minutes until rosy-fragrant, then strain.
Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl and arrange sliced ripe plum and toasted oats on top.
Drizzle the sweet floral shiso syrup across the bowl and enjoy.
tips: A few drops of lemon juice turn red shiso infusion a gorgeous vibrant magenta.
Ripe peaches or strawberries pair equally well with shiso.

recipes.title: Chilled Buckwheat Soba, Cucumber & Fresh Shiso Bowl
recipes.summary: Classic cooling Japanese lunch pairing tender buckwheat soba noodles, crisp cucumber, shelled edamame, light soy-vinegar dressing, and bright shiso.

ingredient_details.item: fresh shiso leaves, finely sliced (or 1.5 tsp dried)

steps: Boil soba noodles 5 to 6 minutes until tender, rinse thoroughly under cold water, and drain well.
Whisk soy sauce, rice vinegar, toasted sesame oil, and 2 tbsp cold water in a bowl.
Toss chilled noodles, cucumber, edamame, and fragrant shiso with the dressing and serve cool.
tips: Shiso is the signature cooling summer herb for Japanese chilled soba and somen noodles.
Snip noodles briefly with kitchen shears for effortless fork pickup.

recipes.title: Chilled Hiyayakko Silken Tofu with Ginger & Shiso
recipes.summary: Classic Japanese no-cook protein lunch plating pillowy chilled silken tofu over cucumber and rice, crowned with fresh ginger, scallions, soy sauce, and shiso.

ingredient_details.item: fresh shiso leaves, thinly sliced (or 1 tsp dried)

steps: Arrange chilled silken tofu blocks neatly alongside crisp cucumber slices in two shallow bowls.
Mound grated fresh ginger, sliced scallions, and fragrant shiso across the top of the tofu.
Drizzle lightly with soy sauce and toasted sesame oil and eat gently with a spoon.
tips: Hiyayakko requires zero heat, takes 6 minutes, and offers custard-soft plant protein that is effortless to swallow.
Serve with a small bowl of warm rice on the side.

recipes.title: Poached Salmon, Cucumber & Shiso Sushi-Style Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Fresh chirashi-inspired lunch bowl layering lightly vinegared rice, tender flaked poached salmon, avocado, cucumber, and fragrant shiso.

ingredient_details.item: fresh shiso leaves, thinly sliced (or 1.5 tsp dried yukari)
warm cooked short-grain or jasmine rice

steps: Fold rice vinegar and half the shiso gently into warm cooked rice and divide between two bowls.
Top neatly with moist flakes of poached salmon, cubed avocado, and diced cucumber.
Finish with remaining shiso and toasted sesame seeds.
tips: Shiso and salmon are one of Japanese cuisine's brightest omega-3 partnerships.
Ready in 8 minutes using pre-poached salmon.

recipes.title: Light Shiso, Mushroom & Baby Spinach Miso Soup
recipes.summary: Restorative clear miso broth simmering tender mushrooms, soft tofu, and spinach, lifted right at serving with aromatic shredded shiso.

ingredient_details.item: fresh shiso leaves, thinly sliced (or 1.5 tsp dried)
thinly sliced shiitake or cremini mushrooms

steps: Simmer water, sliced mushrooms, and grated ginger 7 minutes until mushrooms turn tender.
Turn heat off, slip in cubed soft tofu and baby spinach, and whisk miso smooth in a ladleful of warm broth before returning it to the pot.
Ladle into warm bowls and crown generously with fragrant shiso right before sipping.
tips: Adding shiso at the very end preserves its bright citrus-mint perfume in steaming broth.
Soothing, hydrating, and completely plant-based.

recipes.title: Poached Chicken, Crisp Pear & Shiso Lettuce Wraps
recipes.summary: Tender shredded poached chicken, sweet diced pear, and cucumber dressed in light lime-sesame vinaigrette with fragrant shiso inside tender lettuce leaves.

ingredient_details.item: fresh shiso leaves (or 1.5 tsp dried flakes)

steps: Whisk lime juice, toasted sesame oil, and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Toss shredded poached chicken, finely diced pear, diced cucumber, and finely snipped shiso with the dressing.
Spoon into soft butter lettuce cups (or tuck into a warm whole-wheat tortilla) and serve cool.
tips: If you have large fresh green shiso leaves, you can even tuck a whole leaf right inside each butter lettuce cup as a fragrant wrapper.
Crisp, refreshing, and dairy-free.

recipes.title: Tender Japanese Shiso & Ginger Chicken Tsukune Patties
recipes.summary: Juicy, pillow-soft ground chicken patties mixed with finely shredded shiso, grated ginger, and scallions, glazed gently with light soy-honey sauce.

ingredient_details.item: fresh shiso leaves, finely chopped (or 2 tsp dried)

steps: Mix ground chicken, chopped shiso, grated ginger, scallions, and 1 tbsp soy sauce gently into 6 soft oval patties.
Sear patties in oil over medium heat 3 minutes per side, then add remaining 1 tbsp soy sauce, honey, and 3 tbsp water; cover and steam-glaze 5 minutes until 165 F.
Serve warm over steamed rice with pan glaze spooned over top.
tips: Adding a splash of water and covering the skillet guarantees extraordinarily moist, soft patties.
Traditional Japanese shiso tsukune is a crowd favorite for both weeknights and meal prep.

recipes.title: Foil-Steamed Salmon with Fresh Shiso, Lemon & Mushrooms
recipes.summary: Moist parchment-steamed Japanese salmon packets layered with thinly sliced mushrooms, lemon, light soy sauce, and fragrant shiso leaves.

ingredient_details.item: fresh shiso leaves (or 1.5 tsp dried flakes)
thinly sliced shiitake or cremini mushrooms

steps: Heat oven to 400 F. Lay sliced mushrooms on two squares of parchment paper and set a salmon fillet atop each.
Top each fillet with shiso, a lemon slice, half the soy sauce, and oil, then fold parchment edges tightly into sealed packets.
Bake 13 to 14 minutes until salmon is steaming and fork-tender, opening packets carefully at the table.
tips: Parchment steaming locks in every drop of omega-3 moisture and shiso aroma with virtually zero dishwashing.
Serve with warm jasmine rice or soft noodles.

recipes.title: Wafu Japanese Shiso, Basil & Edamame Olive Oil Pasta
recipes.summary: Tokyo-style wafu short pasta tossed with sweet cherry tomatoes, shelled edamame, garlic olive oil, a splash of soy sauce, and bright shiso.

ingredient_details.item: fresh shiso leaves, thinly shredded (or 2 tsp dried)

steps: Boil short pasta per package directions, adding frozen edamame during the last 3 minutes; reserve 1/3 cup pasta water.
Gently warm olive oil, sliced garlic, and cherry tomatoes in a skillet 4 minutes until tomatoes soften.
Toss drained pasta, edamame, soy sauce, and pasta water into the skillet, turn off heat, and fold in generous fragrant shiso.
tips: Wafu (Japanese-style) pasta with garlic, soy sauce, and fresh shiso is wildly popular across Japan for good reason.
Completely plant-based and ready in under 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Soft Miso-Glazed Eggplant, Tofu & Shiso Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Custard-soft roasted Japanese eggplant and golden tofu glazed with sweet white miso and finished with bright ribbons of fresh shiso.

ingredient_details.item: fresh shiso leaves, thinly sliced (or 1.5 tsp dried)

steps: Heat oven to 400 F; toss cubed eggplant and tofu with oil on a parchment-lined sheet pan and roast 15 minutes until soft and lightly golden.
Drizzle thinned white miso and grated ginger over the tray and roast 3 more minutes to glaze.
Pile over bowls of warm rice and shower generously with bright aromatic shiso.
tips: Bright herbal shiso cuts cleanly through rich sweet miso and velvety eggplant.
Naturally dairy-free and very gentle to chew.

recipes.title: Ginger, Shiso & Clear Broth Poached Cod with Bok Choy
recipes.summary: Clean, delicate white fish fillets and baby bok choy poached in ginger-soy broth and finished generously with aromatic shiso leaves.

ingredient_details.item: fresh shiso leaves, thinly sliced (or 1.5 tsp dried)

steps: Simmer vegetable broth, soy sauce, and grated ginger in a wide skillet for 2 minutes.
Nestle cod fillets and baby bok choy into the gentle broth, cover, and poach 8 minutes until fish flakes softly.
Plate into shallow bowls, drizzle toasted sesame oil, and crown with bright shiso right before serving.
tips: Light, clean, and calming for evening meals.
Serve over warm short-grain rice or soft udon noodles.

recipes.title: Ruby Raspberry, Blueberry & Shiso Botanical Smoothie
recipes.summary: Antioxidant-rich berry smoothie uniting frozen blueberries, raspberries, Greek yogurt, milk, and fragrant shiso leaves.

ingredient_details.item: fresh red or green shiso leaves (or 1/2 tsp dried)

steps: Combine milk, Greek yogurt, shiso, frozen blueberries, frozen raspberries, and honey in a blender.
Blend 50 seconds until smooth, vibrant purple-red, and fragrant.
Pour into a chilled glass and enjoy immediately.
tips: Red shiso (akajiso) shares the same rich purple anthocyanin pigments as dark berries.
Tastes bright, floral, and clean—like berries with a hint of mint and citrus.

recipes.title: Japanese Peach, Ginger & Shiso Oat-Milk Smoothie
recipes.summary: Velvety dairy-free smoothie pairing sweet frozen peaches, oat milk, fresh ginger, lemon, and delicate aromatic shiso.
steps: Place oat milk, shiso, frozen peach slices, grated ginger, and lemon juice in a blender.
Blend 50 seconds until pale sunset-gold and silky smooth.
Serve cold right away.
tips: Sweet white or yellow peaches harmonize effortlessly with shiso's minty-floral character.
Naturally dairy-free and caffeine-free.

recipes.title: Crisp Pear, Baby Spinach & Green Shiso Smoothie
recipes.summary: Refreshing Japanese garden green smoothie blending juicy ripe pear, baby spinach, banana, shiso, lemon, and cold water.

ingredient_details.item: fresh green shiso leaves (or 1/2 tsp dried)

steps: Blend cold water, baby spinach, and shiso 20 seconds until bright green and liquefied.
Add diced ripe pear, frozen banana, and lemon juice and blend 35 seconds until silky and frosty.
Pour into a tall glass and sip crisp.
tips: Green shiso (aoba) turns everyday spinach-pear smoothies bright, crisp, and cooling.
Hydrating, dairy-free, and nut-free.

recipes.title: Sweet Strawberry, Banana & Shiso Silk Smoothie
recipes.summary: Rosy everyday smoothie blending frozen strawberries, banana, almond milk, plain yogurt, and bright aromatic shiso.
steps: Combine almond milk, Greek yogurt, shiso, frozen strawberries, and banana in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until rosy, frosty, and smooth.
Serve cold immediately.
tips: Shiso works like sweet basil or mint in strawberry smoothies—just more complex and citrusy.
Zero added sweetener needed.

recipes.title: Golden Mango, Pineapple & Shiso Tropical Smoothie
recipes.summary: Sunny tropical smoothie uniting frozen mango, pineapple, coconut water, lime juice, and fragrant shiso.
steps: Add coconut water, shiso, frozen mango, frozen pineapple, and lime juice to a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until bright golden and smooth.
Pour into a chilled glass and enjoy immediately.
tips: A light, electrolyte-rich tropical cooler with zero dairy.
Add 2 tbsp plain yogurt if you'd like extra creaminess.

recipes.title: Traditional Japanese Ruby Shiso & Lemon Juice (Shiso Juusu)
recipes.summary: Iconic Japanese summer tonic gently simmering red or green shiso leaves, then brightening with fresh lemon juice and honey until jewel-bright over ice.

ingredient_details.item: packed fresh red or green shiso leaves (or 2 tbsp dried shiso)

steps: Bring water to a gentle boil, add shiso leaves, and simmer softly 6 to 8 minutes until deeply aromatic.
Strain out the leaves cleanly and stir honey and freshly squeezed lemon juice into the warm infusion—watching red shiso magically glow ruby-red.
Chill completely and serve over tall glasses of ice.
tips: Japanese families brew pitchers of shiso juusu every summer to stay cool, hydrated, and refreshed.
Keeps 5 days chilled in the refrigerator and tastes great splashed with sparkling water.

recipes.title: Crisp Cucumber, Lime & Shiso Spa Cooler
recipes.summary: Cooling garden press blending chopped cucumber, cold water, bright lime juice, and shiso leaves, strained silky smooth over ice.

ingredient_details.item: fresh green shiso leaves (or 3/4 tsp dried)

steps: Blend chopped cucumber, chilled water, lime juice, honey, and shiso 20 seconds.
Strain through a fine-mesh sieve into a glass filled with ice.
Sip cold and crisp right away.
tips: Refreshing like a spa drink with shiso's unique cinnamon-mint-citrus finish.
Skip honey for a completely sugar-free botanical press.

recipes.title: Orchard Apple, Ginger & Brewed Shiso Iced Tonic
recipes.summary: Crisp pressed apple juice layered with chilled steeped shiso tea, fresh ginger juice, and bright lemon over ice.
steps: Steep shiso in hot water covered 4 minutes, then strain cleanly.
Pour the fragrant shiso infusion, pressed apple juice, ginger juice, and lemon juice over ice cubes.
Stir gently and enjoy chilled.
tips: Naturally sweet from apple juice with a lively aromatic finish.
Caffeine-free and soothing any afternoon.

recipes.title: Chilled Watermelon, Lime & Shiso Summer Press
recipes.summary: Jewel-red seedless watermelon juice blended briefly with fragrant shiso leaves and fresh lime, strained crystal smooth.

ingredient_details.item: fresh red or green shiso leaves (or 1 tsp dried)

steps: Blend watermelon cubes, lime juice, chilled water, and shiso 20 seconds.
Strain through a fine sieve into two ice-filled glasses.
Serve immediately while frosty and crisp.
tips: Watermelon and shiso are a wildly refreshing Japanese summer favorite.
Zero added sweetener and deeply hydrating.

recipes.title: Sparkling Pear, Citrus & Steeped Shiso Refresher
recipes.summary: Light sparkling mocktail pairing chilled brewed shiso tea, pure pear juice, lemon-lime juice, and bubbly water.
steps: Steep shiso in 1/3 cup hot water covered 4 minutes and strain cleanly.
Pour the strained infusion, pear juice, lemon juice, and lime juice over ice cubes.
Top with sparkling water, stir lightly, and serve cold.
tips: Combining lemon and lime juice mimics Japanese yuzu citrus alongside delicate shiso.
Festive, crisp, and completely alcohol- and caffeine-free.
